visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a modern, well-lit apartment living room. A man in a white oversized t-shirt and grey pants stands near a wooden dining table, looking at his phone. A woman's hand holding a phone enters the frame. (2) The camera zooms into a phone screen displaying a bank transaction detail with the amount $35,000. Black text overlays appear on the screen. (3) The man is handed a black tablet displaying large white text prompts. He reacts with surprise and excitement, moving towards a shelving unit. He searches through items, picking up a small white paper. (4) The camera follows the man to a different corner of the room near a large potted fiddle-leaf fig plant. He reads another prompt on the tablet and finds a hidden card under the plant pot. (5) The woman presents the man with a white rectangular smartphone box. He holds it with both hands, smiling broadly and looking at the camera. (6) He excitedly opens the box to find only a clear plastic phone case inside. His expression shifts from joy to confusion and slight disappointment. (7) The woman then hands him a new, orange-colored smartphone. He sits on a rug on the floor, inspecting the device with a wide grin. (8) The video concludes with the man leaning into the camera for a close-up, smiling and then moving forward as if to kiss the lens.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful, high-pitched female voice calling 'Lao gong' over an upbeat, rhythmic electronic pop track. A male voice responds with a questioning tone. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect triggers a transition. The woman explains she received her salary, and the man repeats the word with curiosity. (3) A cartoonish 'boing' SFX sounds as the scavenger hunt task is presented. The man's speech rate increases as he excitedly shouts the required phrases. (4) Frequent hard cuts in the audio track correspond with the man moving and rustling through items. Laughter from both the male and female voices is audible in the background. (5) A dramatic swell in the music occurs when the gift box is presented. This is followed by a humorous 'fail' sound effect when the man discovers the empty box. (6) High-arousal shouting and laughter dominate as the real phone is revealed. The BGM maintains a steady, happy tempo throughout the interaction. (7) The video ends with a distinct 'smack' sound effect representing a kiss, as the male voice declares his love for his wife.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lifestyle vlog capturing a playful prank and surprise between a couple. It aims to entertain viewers through the husband's emotional rollercoaster—from excitement during a scavenger hunt to confusion at a fake gift, and finally joy upon receiving a real iPhone 15 Pro Max.
